# ClientWidth <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Windows](BlitzPlus-Windows)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ClientWidth:Int32 group:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a window, panel, tabber, canvas or the desktop. Other gadgets can give meaningless numbers. |

**Returns:** The usable width in pixels.

## Description

Gives the width of the area of a group that gadgets can use, without frame or scroll bars. For [Desktop](Desktop) it is the width of the primary display, including the area under the task bar and start menu.

## Differences

* The desktop is as big as the primary display (all of it, not only the area free of the task bar), where there is a display to ask. A window of the operating system has the frame and the title bar of the system, which are not part of its client area; a menu bar or a status bar is.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Client", 10, 10, 200, 150, Desktop(), 15)
; A gadget as wide as the inside of its window fits exactly.
CreateButton "Wide", 0, 0, ClientWidth(win), 24, win
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
